note: Same 40 seeds in every arm. on = all story numbers, keeping the logbooks and the counter whole; off = scenes still open but every story number is neutral; beats = only that scene's numbers removed; choices = one choice fixed per path, the other at its default. The share of each particle found on the far side is the solver's in every arm. Do not edit by hand.

hours.label: hours the five nights took (shown on the night card): shots, seals, failed checks, the stove, the generator and waiting for the sun

failures.label: failures (counted on screen): a seal the check rejected

shots.label: shots fired over the five nights (counted on screen); each one takes a shot of battery

empties.label: times the battery ran empty (banner on screen): an hour on the generator while the line stood, five hours in the dark waiting for the sun after it was cut

red.label: shots fired with the battery in the red (below 3 shots left)
